decision: The competitor (Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: Driving unnecessarily slowly between Turns 15 and 16.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 18 (Lance Stroll), the driver of Car 42 (Frederik Vesti), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, team radio and in-car video evidence. The driver was unable to see the approaching car in his mirrors and the team failed to give him adequate warning – effectively less than one second. The driver did remain on his line and hence there was no risk of collision however the team failed to keep him properly informed of the approach of Car 42. On a circuit where there are numerous corners where rearwards visibility is very limited and there is the potential for high speed deltas between those on preparation laps and push laps, it is essential that teams effectively communicate the approach of other cars to their drivers. For this reason, a fine for the team is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Infringement Car 18 Alleged Driving Unnecessarily Slowly
